reviews.summary: Last round's fix is in. Four complete, specific letters to adapt tonight, a repeatable four-part shape, card-length versions and how to hand it over, where the top results are lists of generic paragraphs; the product comes once, at the end, with an honest note on what costs money.

Open-when envelopes fixed in both languages; pricing, free-demo and Spanish template names verified against the manifests, messages/en.json and es.json; every link resolves. Only polish: 'la plantilla La carta' to avoid reading as 'the letter is free'.

Unlike the Pinterest boards and 20-to-61-item generic letter lists that rank, it teaches a four-part shape, shows it in four distinct full letters, then covers card lines, what to avoid and how to hand it over, linking its neighbours without duplicating them.
